description: SVG-based wireframe canvas. Renders WireframeDocument elements as scalable SVG shapes and handles pan, zoom, drag-move, resize (8-handle), rubber-band multi-select, element drop from toolbox, keyboard nudge, and context menu. Communicates with wireframe-designer.js for all mouse/touch interactions. All mutations go through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Typically used as a child of TmWireframeEditor rather than directly.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document to display and edit. Mutated in-place; bind with @bind-Document.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every mutation so callers can persist the document.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Render grid lines on the canvas background.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in SVG units (pixels). 0 = disabled.

parameters.name: SnapToObjects
parameters.description: When true, dragged elements snap to edges/centers of other elements.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables all editing interactions (drag, resize, drop). Pan via middle-mouse or Space+drag still works.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user changes the selection. Payload is an array of selected element IDs.

parameters.name: OnConnectorSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user changes the connector selection.

parameters.name: OnConnectorCreated
parameters.description: Raised when the user creates a connector by dragging from one element to another.

parameters.name: OnDeleteConnectors
parameters.description: Raised when user requests deletion of selected connectors.

parameters.name: OnConnectorWaypointDragged
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string ConnectorId, int WaypointIndex, double X, double Y)>
parameters.description: Raised when user drags a connector waypoint to a new position.

parameters.name: OnConnectorWaypointAdded
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string ConnectorId, double X, double Y)>
parameters.description: Raised when user double-clicks a connector path to add a new waypoint.

parameters.name: OnConnectorDragged
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string ConnectorId, double Dx, double Dy)>
parameters.description: Raised when user drags a selected connector to move all its waypoints.

parameters.name: OnToolModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user switches tool mode via H/V keyboard shortcuts. Values: 'select' | 'pan'.

parameters.name: OnUndo
parameters.description: Raised when Ctrl+Z is pressed and no CommandStack is cascaded.

parameters.name: OnRedo
parameters.description: Raised when Ctrl+Y/Ctrl+Shift+Z is pressed and no CommandStack is cascaded.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the canvas wrapper div.

parameters.name: OnCopyStyleRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user requests copy style (Ctrl+Shift+C).

parameters.name: OnPasteStyleRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user requests paste style (Ctrl+Shift+V).

parameters.name: OnPasteSizeRequested
parameters.description: Raised when user requests paste size (Ctrl+Shift+S).

parameters.name: OnElementContextMenuRequested
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string Id, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when user opens context menu on an element (right-click).

parameters.name: OnConnectorContextMenuRequested
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string Id, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when user opens context menu on a connector (right-click).

parameters.name: OnCanvasContextMenuRequested
parameters.type: EventCallback<(double SvgX, double SvgY, double ScreenX, double ScreenY)>
parameters.description: Raised when user opens context menu on empty canvas (right-click).

parameters.name: OnCloseContextMenu
parameters.description: Raised when context menu should close (click outside / Escape).

parameters.name: OnViewBoxChangedEvent
parameters.type: EventCallback<(double X, double Y, double W, double H)>
parameters.description: Raised when the viewBox changes (pan/zoom).

parameters.name: OnCanvasMouseMoved
parameters.description: Raised when mouse moves over the canvas (SVG coordinates).

publicMethods.name: SetToolMode(string mode)
publicMethods.description: Programmatically switches JS tool mode. Values: 'select' | 'pan'.

publicMethods.name: UpdateCanvasSize(double w, double h)
publicMethods.description: Notifies JS of updated canvas dimensions after a ResizeCanvasCommand.

publicMethods.name: SelectElements(params string[] ids)
publicMethods.description: Sets JS-side selection highlights without raising OnSelectionChanged.

publicMethods.name: ExportSvg()
publicMethods.description: Returns the canvas as a clean SVG string with all selection handles stripped.

examples.title: Standalone canvas (without full editor)
examples.code:
<TmWireframeDesignerCanvas @ref="_canvas"
                           Document="_document"
                           DocumentChanged="OnChanged"
                           OnSelectionChanged="OnSelect" />

@code {
    private TmWireframeDesignerCanvas? _canvas;
    private WireframeDocument _document = new();

    private void OnSelect(string[] ids)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Selected: {string.Join(", ", ids)}");
    }
}
